instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a sunny park with soft-focus trees in the background, two young girls share a warm embrace. On the left, the curly-haired girl in rust-colored overalls and a white cardigan (R1) stands facing forward, smiling happily at the camera. On the right, the girl with a pink headband and a light pink cardigan (R2) stands close, wrapping her arm around the curly-haired girl's (R1) waist while smiling with her eyes cast down. The scene is backlit by warm, bright sunlight filtering through the trees, creating a soft, glowing atmosphere with natural colors.
